description: Changes the signals that already feed a campaign. remove takes one off: it is paused when no other campaign reads it, and the people it brought stay. match any ("qualquer sinal") lets each signal bring companies on its own; match all ("todos os sinais") keeps only the companies every signal brought, each within its own window. feedOn false pauses every signal of the campaign; feedOn true turns them back on. On an active campaign, feedOn true turns paused signals on and they spend credits every day: the first call returns status quote with the monthly credit ceiling and changes nothing; the call with confirmed true applies it. Only a workspace owner or admin can change it.

confirmed.description: true only after the user agreed to the monthly cost a quote returned.

feedOn.description: false pauses the campaign's signals; true turns them back on.

remove.description: A signal (monitorId) to take off the campaign.
